scenes.say: Is your app actually ready for production? How can you show it’s healthy and observable?

scenes.label: Health
scenes.sub: Add health checks and map a health endpoint.
scenes.say: Start with health checks. Register them and map a health endpoint so monitoring tools can track your app’s status.
Next, use structured logging for diagnostics, add distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, and expose metrics to monitor your app.

scenes.title: Health & Logging in Startup
scenes.say: In your setup, register health checks, map the health endpoint, enable logging, and add OpenTelemetry tracing.

scenes.question: How do you expose a health endpoint?
scenes.right: Register health checks and map a health endpoint for monitoring tools.
scenes.say: Don’t forget: you need to register health checks and actually map the endpoint. Logging and tracing alone aren’t enough.
